reproduction: Restore lossless archives, repeat all geometry/PCA calculations and require exact equality of the stored geometry results. No scans, native rerun or new setting.
rejection_analysis: Reconstruct every stored native query acceptance/rejection from its recorded candidate IDs/distances and row constraints, using the unchanged native gates. Mutually exclusive reason counts. No new threshold.
groups: All selected moving; inherited natural-bad and other; oracle-bad-length and other. Retain every oracle length/vector failure and S2S entry. No successful subset.
control_reporting: First-order forward correction and reconstructed finite first-update vector error, plus improvement/adverse counts across every moving case. These are fixed-association first updates from GT, not repeated solver/trajectory results.
figure: Every moving pair retained, two scatter panels for the two predeclared ground-PCA controls. Native-equation forward correction versus control, in percent GT step.
limits: No estimate of a population success rate, no full-trajectory score, no causal isolation of GT/calibration errors, no new estimator. Normal disagreement does not establish that PCA is correct.

analysis_runtime.meaning: Collection Python inherited unset selectors (library default); reproduce that policy. The protocol environment of1 was applied to native subprocesses, not retroactively to the already-started NumPy controller. This metadata correction does not change native parameters/data or the exact offline equality check.
